kill_cloud.description: true pauses every cloud model call on every client; on-device work and the pick list keep going.

use_limited_use_tokens.description: Clients send limited-use App Check tokens to Firebase AI Logic (replay protection).

cloud_model_web.description: Cloud model for the web command post. Must be on shared/constants/models.json.

sighting_template_id.description: Server prompt template for the web command post's consented cloud read of a sighting note (shared/templates).

photo_template_id.description: Server prompt template for the web command post's consented cloud read of a family photo (shared/templates).

cloud_model_ios.description: Cloud model for the iOS searcher app. Must be on shared/constants/models.json.

cloud_model_android.description: Cloud model for the Android family app's note read. Must be on shared/constants/models.json.

clip_model.description: Cloud model for the Android family app's camera clip read. Must be on shared/constants/models.json.

clip_template_id.description: Server prompt template for the Android family app's consented cloud read of a camera clip (shared/templates).

voice_template_id.description: Server prompt template for spoken assignment changes on iOS (shared/templates); empty means on-device speech only.

token_budget_fraction.description: Share of the on-device context window the iOS app may fill before it routes a read to the cloud (0 to 1).

minimum_version_ios.description: iOS builds below this version show the update screen.

minimum_version_android.description: Android version codes below this show the update screen. Raise only after the repo is public and the release APK is a GitHub Release asset (docs/PRODUCTION-CHECKLIST.md).

time_machine_enabled.description: false hides the web command post's clip time machine; the sighting card and the person-in-view band stay.
